name: Daring Terror
source:
After waking up, you decide to ask your friends (Amelia, Lily, Rose, Elizabeth and Clementine) to hang out during Halloween. Each person dresses up and decides to hang out at yours and Amelia's apartment to decide what they should do during Halloween. 

Explore a haunted house, watch movies and hang out with your friends in Daring Terror.

[From [url=https://thediamondcryst.itch.io/daring-terror]Itch.io[/url]]
